an8.81:1.1: Satisampajaññe bhikkhave asati satisampajaññavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ,
an8.81:1.2: hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatupaniso hoti indriyasaṃvaro,
an8.81:1.3: indriyasaṃvare asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sīlaṃ,
an8.81:1.4: sīle asati sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi,
an8.81:1.5: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an8.81:1.6: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an8.81:1.7: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an8.81:1.8: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno, tassa papaṭikā pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an8.81:1.9: evam eva kho bhikkhave satisampajaññe asati satisampajaññavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ,
an8.81:1.10: hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an8.81:2.1: Satisampajaññe bhikkhave sati satisampajaññasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ,
an8.81:2.2: hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti indriyasaṃvaro,
an8.81:2.3: indriyasaṃvare sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sīlaṃ,
an8.81:2.4: sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi,
an8.81:2.5: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
an8.81:2.6: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo,
an8.81:2.7: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an8.81:2.8: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno, tassa papaṭikā pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an8.81:2.9: evam eva kho bhikkhave satisampajaññe satisampajaññasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ,
an8.81:2.10: hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
